slides.h1: 5 signs your app idea is worth building.
slides.lead: Before you open Xcode, check these.
You'll understand it better than anyone. And you won't quit when it gets boring.
Group chats, spreadsheets, notice boards. A workaround proves the need is real.

slides.kicker: 03 · You can name who it's for
slides.lead: If you can't describe your first user in one line, you can't reach them.
A building, a community, a niche. If you can't find them, ads won't either.
If it only works with a million users, it'll never get its first hundred.

slides.h2: Build for a problem, not an idea.
